# Custom Message

MessageContentView checks the host renderer registry, then built-ins, then UnknownMessage. OrderCard, PaymentCard, ProductCard, RobotCard, and ApprovalCard do not require MessageBubble changes.

## Principle

The kit provides sensible defaults; capabilities own business availability; host configuration owns trimming and order; targeted extension points replace only what truly differs.

## Contract

A registration receives typed content and presentation context. Theme still comes from semantic tokens, while MessageCapabilities and host extensions own actions.

## Platforms

Vue, Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI align semantically while retaining native syntax and interaction.

## Validation

Configuration tests cover defaults, removal, hiding, disabling, reordering, custom entries, and capability filtering.
